## Blast radius

- [ ] Living document (`owner:` reviewed, `review_due:` set)
- [ ] Decision record added or superseded (`Decisions/`)
- [ ] Structure, schema, tags or rules (needs a decision record)
- [ ] Nothing above: ordinary note or input

## Checks

- [ ] `brain health` passes (CI runs it)
- [ ] No secret, no personal data beyond work contact details
- [ ] Facts carry `[source: ...; since: YYYY-MM-DD]`
